# harness_platform_idp_integration_kind_mapping (Data Source)

Data source for the mapping of one kind of an IDP integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harness_platform_idp_integration_kind_mapping" "example" {
  integration_id = "servicenow_prod"
  org_id         = "default"
  kind           = "cmdb_ci_service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) Identifier of the integration.
- `kind` (String) Kind.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier of the project.

### Read-Only

- `correlation` (List of Object) Links records to existing entities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--correlation))

- `field_mapping` (List of Object) Maps a source field to an entity field. Airbyte types. Omitted, the type's defaults apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field_mapping))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `idp_kind` (String) Entity kind, e.g. component.
- `idp_type` (String) Entity type, e.g. service.
- `ingestion` (List of Object) Custom types: JQ that builds the entity from a payload. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ingestion))
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the mapping is the type's default.
- `payload_schema` (String) JSON schema of the payload; read-only.
- `revision` (Number) The integration's revision.
- `unique_identifier_field` (String) Source field that identifies an entity. Can't change on Airbyte types.
- `updated` (Number) Last update time, in milliseconds since the epoch.
